structuredContent.content:
name: Independent Maintained Mods

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'mod_de_jure_conquest/**'
      - 'mod_change_holding_types/**'
      - 'tools/independent_mod_release.py'
      - 'tools/test_independent_mod_release.py'
      - 'tools/translate_localization_minimax.py'
      - 'tools/extract_auto_upgrade_buildings.py'
      - '.github/workflows/independent-maintained-mods.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'mod_de_jure_conquest/**'
      - 'mod_change_holding_types/**'
      - 'tools/independent_mod_release.py'
      - 'tools/test_independent_mod_release.py'
      - 'tools/translate_localization_minimax.py'
      - 'tools/extract_auto_upgrade_buildings.py'
      - '.github/workflows/independent-maintained-mods.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_localization:
        description: 'Run the explicitly authorized nine-language release audit'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  static:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    env:
      GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.longpaths
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'true'
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: cmd
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Test shared runtime projection
        run: python -X utf8 tools/test_independent_mod_release.py
      - name: Check de jure conquest without installed CK3
        run: python -X utf8 mod_de_jure_conquest/tools/validate_static.py --no-installed-game --report "%RUNNER_TEMP%\de-jure-static.json"
      - name: Check holding conversion without installed CK3
        run: python -X utf8 mod_change_holding_types/tools/validate_static.py --report "%RUNNER_TEMP%\holding-static.json"
      - name: Check deterministic product builds
        run: |
          python -X utf8 mod_de_jure_conquest/tools/build_release.py --check
          if not "%errorlevel%"=="0" exit /b %errorlevel%
          python -X utf8 mod_change_holding_types/tools/build_release.py --check
          if not "%errorlevel%"=="0" exit /b %errorlevel%
      - name: Explicit release localization audit
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_localization }}
        run: |
          python -X utf8 mod_de_jure_conquest/tools/validate_static.py --no-installed-game --release-localization --report "%RUNNER_TEMP%\de-jure-release-localization.json"
          if not "%errorlevel%"=="0" exit /b %errorlevel%
          python -X utf8 mod_change_holding_types/tools/validate_static.py --release-localization --report "%RUNNER_TEMP%\holding-release-localization.json"
          if not "%errorlevel%"=="0" exit /b %errorlevel%

# Official runners verify structure and reproducibility only. CK3/Steam live
# acceptance and Workshop publication require the separately recorded local run.
